actuation.select_first: Select one or more keys above to edit them.
actuation.mode_help_fixed: The key acts at a fixed depth and releases above it.
actuation.mode_help_rapid: Past the actuation point the key acts and releases as soon as it moves down or up by the sensitivity.
actuation.mode_help_rapid_split: Rapid trigger with separate press and release sensitivity.
actuation.point_help: Depth at which the key acts (0 = top).
actuation.sensitivity_help: How far the key must move to act again or release.
actuation.dead_band_help: Travel ignored at the top and at the bottom, against chatter from small movements.
actuation.switch_help: Calibrate the keys after changing their switch type (Live page).
actuation.reset_help: Resets the actuation and rapid-trigger settings of every key to the factory values.
actuation.reset_confirm: Reset the trigger settings of ALL keys to factory values? Your own actuation points and rapid-trigger settings are lost (an automatic backup is made before the first change).
